_: RxGuard v1.8.0 -- Daily dose, the total per ingredient.
Every assertion is about behaviour v1.7.0 did not have: it has no
dose_view, no /dose page, no Daily dose card and no DC rule, so the
reconstructed previous build fails each one. The fixture's molecules are
invented, so no assertion can pass by accident on a real record.

assertions.name: 01 an ingredient inside a combination counts into the standalone pool
02 over the ceiling is RED, with the time it frees
03 the dose RED is counted in the page headline and GutLog's banner
04 one generic by two routes is one pool
05 a varying-strength dose is read from the strengths picked
06 a once-a-day ingredient is not doubled by an earlier dose time
07 an addition on top of the nightly regular raises the class load
08 the same product logged twice minutes apart is named, not hidden
09 a dose whose amount cannot be read is reported, not silently zero
10 a ceiling set on /dose overrides the file and is confirmed
11 /astaken carries the Daily dose card and the nav link
12 without a rules file the feature is off and says so
13 GutLog being down is a message on /dose, not an exception
